title: City of Melbourne Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE): the boundaries of its city blocks
provider: City of Melbourne, Open Data Platform (Opendatasoft Explore API v2.1): dataset blocks-for-census-of-land-use-and-employment-clue
credit: CLUE blocks: City of Melbourne, CC BY 4.0
licence: CC BY 4.0 (the dataset's metadata: license CC BY, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode; checked 2026-11-05)
citation: City of Melbourne, Blocks for Census of Land Use and Employment (CLUE), https://data.melbourne.vic.gov.au/explore/dataset/blocks-for-census-of-land-use-and-employment-clue/
format: GeoJSON (WGS 84): one feature a block, with block_id (the key of every CLUE table), region_name and area_name (its CLUE small area), its polygon (geo_shape) and its point (geo_point_2d).
coverage: The municipality of the City of Melbourne: 603 blocks (checked 2026-11-05).

all.description: Every block of the municipality (about 0.4 MB)
